title: LET scopes bindings sequentially without self-recursion (#NAME?), skips unreferenced error bindings, and binds omitted values as blank
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, LET(name1, value1, ..., calculation) binds names sequentially in lexical scope without putting a name in scope within its own value expression (so =LET(fn,LAMBDA(xx,IF(xx=0,0,fn(xx-1)+1)),fn(4)) evaluates to #NAME?), does not surface errors from unused value expressions (=LET(xx,1/0,7) -> 7), binds an omitted value expression as blank (=LET(x,,ISBLANK(x)) -> TRUE and =LET(x,,x) -> 0), and refuses at formula entry (0x800A03EC) any even or < 3 argument count or duplicate case-folded name (=LET(xx,1,XX,2,xx)).
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 across fn2_questions (fn2_q086-087, fn2_q096-109, fn2_q121-122), Touchstone Formula2 omitted-binding checks (l1.rs lines 1286-1292), and entry measurements in excel-entry.tsv (dc-mx3x).
